l4_steps.name: Define digital channel scope & use-case catalogue
l4_steps.input: Contact centre volume reports, top-10 call driver analysis from Genesys Cloud CX
l4_steps.output: Approved use-case catalogue listing automatable intents (flight status, rebooking, refund, baggage, check-in)
l4_steps.kpi: Use-case coverage ≥70% of top contact drivers
l4_steps.pain_point: Airlines frequently undercount automatable intents by excluding irregular operations (IRROP) scenarios, leaving high-volume disruption contacts undeflected

l4_steps.name: Configure NLU intents, entities & training utterances
l4_steps.input: Use-case catalogue, historical chat transcripts from Salesforce Service Cloud
l4_steps.output: NLU model with ≥50 utterances per intent, entity extraction rules for PNR, flight number, date, airport code
l4_steps.kpi: Intent recognition accuracy ≥88% in offline evaluation
l4_steps.pain_point: Airline-specific entities (IATA airport codes, fare basis codes, PNR formats) require custom entity extractors not available in generic NLU libraries; training data is sparse for low-frequency intents

l4_steps.name: Set containment thresholds & escalation routing rules
l4_steps.input: NLU confidence score ranges, queue capacity SLAs, skills-based routing matrix
l4_steps.output: Escalation policy: confidence <0.70 → clarification prompt; <0.55 → live agent; authenticated transaction failure → priority queue
l4_steps.kpi: Mis-escalation rate <5% (contacts escalated that chatbot could have resolved)
l4_steps.pain_point: Overly aggressive confidence thresholds during IRROP events flood live agent queues; Genesys routing rules require manual override during declared irregular operations

l4_steps.name: UAT regression test chatbot flows & approve release
l4_steps.input: Configured NLU model, test script covering all use-case catalogue scenarios including exception paths
l4_steps.output: UAT sign-off report; failed flows returned to step 1.2 for remediation
l4_steps.kpi: UAT pass rate ≥95% across all intent test cases before prod deployment
l4_steps.pain_point: Regression testing is manual and time-consuming; no automated test harness exists for end-to-end chatbot + PSS API integration paths, increasing release cycle to 3–4 weeks

l4_steps.name: Receive & parse inbound digital interaction
l4_steps.input: Customer message via web chat, mobile app, WhatsApp Business API, or Facebook Messenger
l4_steps.output: Normalised interaction record with channel source, session ID, timestamp, and raw utterance
l4_steps.kpi: Channel availability ≥99.9% uptime; median response latency <800 ms
l4_steps.pain_point: WhatsApp Business API throughput is capped by Meta rate limits during high-demand periods (e.g., weather events); fallback to web chat is not seamlessly communicated to passengers

l4_steps.name: Classify intent & extract booking / loyalty entities
l4_steps.output: Top intent label with confidence score, extracted entities (PNR, flight number, date, loyalty tier)
l4_steps.kpi: Live intent accuracy ≥85%; confidence score logged for every interaction
l4_steps.pain_point: Code-switching (multilingual passengers mixing English with Spanish or Portuguese) degrades CCAI intent accuracy by 10–15%; no per-language model version management currently in place

l4_steps.name: Authenticate customer for transactional self-service
l4_steps.input: Customer-supplied PNR + last name, or loyalty member ID + PIN via Salesforce Service Cloud identity service
l4_steps.output: Authenticated session token; customer profile (booking history, loyalty tier, contact preferences) retrieved
l4_steps.kpi: Authentication success rate ≥92% on first attempt; failed auth rate <3%
l4_steps.pain_point: Passengers frequently misquote 6-character PNR (alpha-numeric confusion); Altéa PSS timeout during peak load causes auth failures that appear as customer errors, inflating escalation rate

l4_steps.name: Execute self-service task via PSS & loyalty APIs
l4_steps.input: Authenticated session, validated intent (rebooking, refund request, seat selection, check-in, baggage add-on, flight status)
l4_steps.output: Transaction confirmation (new PNR, refund reference, boarding pass, baggage receipt) or structured error response
l4_steps.kpi: Self-service transaction completion rate ≥80% for eligible intents; API error rate <1%
l4_steps.pain_point: Altéa PSS fare recalculation during voluntary rebooking via API does not always honour same-day change waiver rules, causing incorrect fare difference charges that require manual agent correction

l4_steps.name: Detect escalation trigger & package conversation context
l4_steps.input: CCAI confidence score below threshold, customer explicit escalation request ("speak to agent"), or transaction API failure flag
l4_steps.output: Escalation event with full conversation transcript, intent history, authentication status, and customer tier
l4_steps.kpi: Context transfer completeness ≥98% (no dropped transcripts); escalation routing latency <5 s
l4_steps.pain_point: During IRROP events, simultaneous escalation spikes overwhelm Genesys routing capacity; lack of dynamic queue prioritisation means high-value (elite tier) passengers wait alongside general queue

l4_steps.name: Route escalation to live agent by skill & priority
l4_steps.input: Escalation event, agent skill matrix (language, fare complexity, loyalty tier authorisation), real-time queue depth
l4_steps.output: Agent assignment with conversation context pre-loaded in Salesforce Service Cloud agent console
l4_steps.kpi: Average speed to answer (ASA) for escalated contacts <90 s; first-contact resolution ≥75%
l4_steps.pain_point: Skills-based routing matrix requires manual update when agents are cross-trained; stale routing tables during shift changes cause mis-routing and repeat transfers

l4_steps.name: Agent reviews transcript & resumes resolution
l4_steps.input: Full chatbot transcript, customer profile (PNR, loyalty tier, prior cases), CCAI-suggested resolution from agent assist
l4_steps.output: Case updated in Salesforce; resolution actioned in Amadeus Altéa PSS (rebooking, waiver, compensation)
l4_steps.kpi: Agent handle time for escalated digital contacts <8 min; re-open rate <5%
l4_steps.pain_point: Agents frequently restart from scratch when CCAI transcript is truncated or context payload exceeds Salesforce Service Cloud screen-pop character limit, negating chatbot deflection savings

l4_steps.name: Ingest low-confidence & failed interaction logs
l4_steps.input: Daily CCAI interaction logs exported via Genesys Data Actions; confidence scores, unmatched utterances, fallback counts
l4_steps.output: Curated dataset of misclassified and unresolved intents ranked by volume and customer impact
l4_steps.kpi: Log ingestion SLA <24 h post-interaction; coverage 100% of chatbot sessions
l4_steps.pain_point: CCAI logs are stored in raw JSON requiring ETL transformation before analysis; no real-time intent failure alerting exists, meaning new failure patterns go undetected for 24–48 h

l4_steps.name: Update training utterances & FAQ knowledge content
l4_steps.input: Prioritised intent gap list, agent feedback on frequently asked questions, product/policy change notifications
l4_steps.output: Updated intent training dataset uploaded to CCAI; revised FAQ articles published in Salesforce Knowledge
l4_steps.kpi: Knowledge article freshness: 100% reviewed within 30 days of policy change; new utterances ≥20 per reclassified intent
l4_steps.pain_point: No automated trigger connects policy change management (e.g., baggage fee updates, new fare rules) to knowledge base update workflow; stale FAQ content causes chatbot to quote superseded policies

l4_steps.name: Retrain, validate & promote NLU model to production
l4_steps.input: Updated training dataset, baseline model accuracy benchmarks from last release
l4_steps.output: Validated NLU model version; A/B test report comparing new vs. current model on held-out test set
l4_steps.kpi: New model accuracy ≥baseline +2%; no regression on existing intents; staging validation pass rate 100%
l4_steps.pain_point: CCAI model versioning is not integrated with airline CI/CD pipeline; manual promotion steps increase risk of deploying untested models to production, with no instant rollback capability

l4_steps.name: Monitor containment rate, CSAT & escalation KPIs
l4_steps.input: Genesys Cloud CX interaction data, Medallia post-interaction CSAT survey results, AWS Redshift chatbot analytics
l4_steps.output: Weekly digital channel performance dashboard: containment rate, CSAT, escalation rate, top unresolved intents
l4_steps.kpi: Chatbot containment rate ≥65%; digital CSAT ≥4.0/5.0; escalation rate <35%
l4_steps.pain_point: Containment rate calculation methodology varies between Genesys and CCAI reporting, creating discrepancies of 5–8 percentage points that obscure true self-service performance

l4_steps.name: Identify intent gaps & journey abandonment patterns
l4_steps.input: Tableau dashboard KPI alerts, session path analysis, drop-off rates by intent and step
l4_steps.output: Root-cause analysis report identifying top 5 intent gaps and highest-abandonment journey points
l4_steps.kpi: Journey abandonment rate <15% per intent flow; report produced within 5 business days of KPI breach
l4_steps.pain_point: Session-level journey analytics require joining Genesys session IDs with CCAI interaction IDs and Salesforce case IDs — three separate identity namespaces with no unified customer journey ID

l4_steps.name: Prioritise & schedule chatbot enhancement backlog
l4_steps.input: Root-cause analysis report, capacity estimates from Conversational AI Engineering team, commercial priority from Revenue Management
l4_steps.output: Prioritised enhancement backlog in Confluence; sprint plan for next NLU model training cycle (step 1.2)
l4_steps.kpi: Backlog groomed and sprint-planned within 10 business days of KPI breach; enhancement cycle ≤6 weeks end-to-end
l4_steps.pain_point: Enhancement prioritisation is often driven by loudest stakeholder rather than quantified passenger impact; lack of a shared ROI model (cost-per-contact avoided) means high-value deflection improvements are deprioritised
